notes: οἱ παρ' αὐτοῦ → *his friends*: the article takes the nominal under rule 22, the pronoun the possessive, and παρά is unrepresented under rule 36's compressed-possessive clause.
ἐξέστη → *He is beside himself* keeps subject and copula with the one verb, headed on *beside*; *himself* is the competing head, named in the unit note.
